profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Wabtec Corp
profile.summary:
Experienced IT professional with broad technology knowledge and proven accomplishments planning, developing, and implementing application systems for 36 years. 

Areas of Expertise
●  Business and Systems Analysis 	        ●  Project Management   	         	●  Change Management   
●  Process Improvement		                ●  Applications Development		●  Property and Casualty
●  Workers Comp and ISO Reporting	●  Policy and Claims Processing	●  Team Management

Key Accomplishments in Recent Employment 
●	Developed new Contract Series reporting and TTX Interchanges payables interfaces for GE Railroad Management Services clients.
●	Workers Comp claims processing implementation on Sedgwick Juris system with policy coverage verification and claims backfeed interfaces to WINS system. 
●	Daily oversight of Accenture production support team and AME activities.
●	Workers Comp electronic policy reporting (WCPOLS) to all states for four carriers resulting in significant manpower and processing cost savings.  
●	Endorsement Forms Fill-In definition and entry system design, development, and implementation.  Resulted in significant manpower savings, allowed market expansion for Workers Comp, and integral to new Aviation policy issuance system developed on the WINS platform. 
●  Multi-Platform Commercial Package Restaurant, Bar and Tavern specialty program implementation with rating and policy issuance on Instec  QuickSolver system, Policy Management, Billing, and ISO reporting on WINS system, claims processing on GuideWire Claim Center system, and claims backfeed to WINS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Car Hire iSeries COBOL applications analysis and software development while working in an agile Scrum team environment.
• Development using embedded SQL , DDM, FTP, IFS  and other iSeries integrated tools.
• Developed new Contract Series reporting and TTX Interchanges payables interfaces for GE Railroad  Management Services clients.

positions.title: President
positions.description: Founded company in 1991 to provide custom analysis, design, development, and other application consulting services to IBM iSeries (AS/400) users.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Integral IT team member responsible for Southfield-WINS applications development, maintenance, and process improvement initiatives for 16 years with QBE (8 years), North Pointe Insurance (2 Years), and Capital City Insurance (6 Years).
•  Identified and corrected many data related problems remaining from a 1997 Capital City conversion and implementation of the WINS system using COBOL and RPG ILE/400.
•  Designed and developed enhancements for Policy Loss Detail reporting, Loss Ratio Reporting, Management Reporting with an on-line selection criteria front-end, Cancel/Reinstate/Non-Renewal processing, NCCI WCPOLS and WCSTAT Bureau Reporting to all states and bureaus, Direct Bill Commissions on Paid and Installment basis processing, Final Audit Ordering and tracking system, Final Audit processing and reporting, Direct Bill Return Premium processing for Non-Financed and Financed business, interfaces to On-Base imaging and workflow system, comprehensive Direct Bill billing and cancellation system based on past due rules, Claims Eligibility Reporting, Medical EDI Reporting, Endorsement Forms fill-in definition and entry, Work Comp automatic rating, endorsement forms attachment, Large Deductible, Retro-Rated, Dividend Plans,  Monthly Reporter policy programs, Preliminary Audits Order Management, and Loss Prevention Management systems.
•  Provided management consulting, group leadership and mentoring, analysis, design, development, project management, training, and technical support services.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Performed an initial evaluation of the client’s implementation of the WINS AS/400 insurance system and made various recommendations and software changes to improve operational efficiencies and data quality.
•  Team leader responsible for the design and AS/400 development portion of an interface between an in-house Web-based policy rating and issuance system and WINS.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Acquired by QBE North America in 2008

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Acquired by North Pointe Insurance Co in 2007

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Worked closely with management to identify long-term solutions for improving customer service, cost containment, controls, and accuracy in reporting of the WINS insurance management system. 
•  Designed and developed major enhancements using COBOL and RPG ILE/400 to Agent Statements, Insured Invoicing, Monthly Reporting policy processing, Policy Audit scheduling, Account Loss Control scheduling, Cancel, Reinstate, and Non-Renewal processing, Risk Experience reporting, Agency Production Reporting, Bureau Reporting to both ISO and NCCI, Electronic Funds Transfer payments, Past Due based cancellation and reinstatement processing, General Ledger and Check Printing interfaces to Freedom Financials system, and Certified Mail interface to Post Master system.
•  Developed user procedures and trained users and programmers.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Team Leader responsible for the selection, customization, and implementation of the WINS insurance management system for the administration of Non-Standard Personal Auto policies and claims.
•  Designed and developed major enhancements for Agency Management and Premium Financing using both COBOL and RPG ILE/400.
•  Designed and developed conversion programs for migrating data from existing RPG/400 SIS Insurance Management System to the new WINS System.
•  Developed user procedures and trained users and programmers.
•  Developed extensive technical documentation on the WINS system.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Lead Programmer/Analyst of a team responsible for the customization and implementation of a purchased RPG/400 Order Entry, Inventory Control, and Sales Reporting system used in eight Gypsum Division manufacturing locations.
•  Designed and implemented interfaces to corporate Software/2000 A/R System.
•  Designed and implemented a Centralized Master Files Maintenance distribution system used by corporate to automatically synchronize remote databases in a near real-time fashion.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Designed and developed custom modifications to an RPG/400 Marketing & Sales Analysis System (MSM) used by various Fortune/500 companies.
•  Specific project responsibilities included the design and development of two major modules for Sales Roll-Up Reporting and Mail List Importing.
•  Extensive use of Open Query File command, Sub-files, Windows, Multi-Language Support, and other functions requiring use of advanced AS/400 coding techniques.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Lead Programmer/Analyst of a team responsible for the development of an on-line RPG/400 Raw Materials Usage Tracking System.
•  Designed Month-End and Year-End functions and controls.
•  Re-Designed and modified major portions of a Plant Communications System that used ICF/400 communications to automatically poll and collect sales data from Remote Systems.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
•  Team member responsible for the implementation and customization of a purchased RPG/400 Apparel Industry Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system that included major components for  inventory control and procurement, production forecasting, job costing, procurement scheduling, process scheduling, order entry, sales forecasting, finished goods inventory management, distribution, and financials.
•  Responsible for all technical aspects of an AS/400, S/38 and IBM Mainframe distributed network.
•  Managed five Programmer/Analysts on various manufacturing applications, hardware, and remote communications projects.
•  Responsible for implementation and support of EDI on the AS/400 for Purchase Orders and Advance Ship Notices.
•  Established Applications Development and System Management standards and developed an in-house change management system used by corporate and eight manufacturing locations.

positions.title: Programmer III
positions.description: •  Performed COBOL development and maintenance for chemicals manufacturing, order processing, and distribution systems in an IBM Mainframe and HP3000 dual environment.
